title: Add private beta installed-layout verifier
summary: Add a read-only verifier for post-install private beta layout evidence.
reason: Clean-machine validation needs a repeatable gate after first launch that proves mutable runtime state moved to per-user AppData while the installed app root remains immutable.
behavior_before: The runbook required checking productization status manually after install, but there was no focused script to verify installed root, AppData runtime roots, migration evidence, and productization payload posture together.
behavior_after: Operators can run a read-only installed-layout verifier after first launch to validate install-root immutability, AppData runtime roots, guarded migration evidence, NSIS-only installer posture, prompted updater posture, and close-readiness gating.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m pytest tests/python/tooling -k private_beta -q - passed (31 passed, 148 deselected)
rollback_plan: Remove the installed-layout verifier script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: The verifier must not run installers, dispatch workflows, download assets, upload releases, mutate GitHub state, modify AppData, or touch media/source/scratch/output paths.
